visual.general_description: Color photograph of one excised reddish tissue specimen lying on a white creased sheet.
visual.detailed_description: A single tissue specimen is centered on a white creased sheet and occupies roughly two thirds of the frame height. It has a pear or bottle-shaped outline, oriented vertically, with a wider rounded upper portion and a narrower tail below. The upper portion mixes red areas with pale yellow-white patches, and its upper-right corner is ragged and a brighter red. The narrower lower portion is darker red with an irregular, ragged outline and a few small whitish specks in its middle. A faint pink smear lies just above the top edge of the specimen and a tiny dark speck lies at the upper left of the sheet. A soft gray shadow falls to the right of the specimen. No scale bar, ruler, labels, arrows, text, panel letters, hands or instruments are visible.

visual.general_description: Color photomicrograph of a stained tissue section showing many dilated vascular spaces of varying size in pink stroma.
visual.detailed_description: The field is filled with numerous thin-walled vascular spaces of varying size and shape, round, oval and elongated, scattered through pink, loosely textured stroma that contains small scattered dark nuclei. Many lumens are densely packed with red-stained cells; others are pale or nearly empty with only a few red cells. The larger red-filled channels lie mainly in the central and right parts of the field. A pale yellow, nearly empty area along the left edge is the edge of the section with a few detached tissue fragments. Staining is pink to red with small purple-blue nuclei. No scale bar, labels, arrows, text or panel letters are visible.
